rv.q: Finding its new home at the Noël Coward Theatre in the West End after an initial run at the National Theatre late last year, THE IMPORTANCE OF BEING EARNEST has a fresh cast of players and opened shop this past week. Olly Alexander and the cast of West End transfer of The Importance of Being Earnest.
This Importance of Being Earnest is far from being left behind 'in the cloakroom at Victoria Station'. It's shimmying and shaking its booty all over the West End stage, and I have to say is 'bravi'!
